title: The Slayton House
description:
Located just 15 minutes from downtown Nashville, The Slayton House is your gateway to both city attractions and suburban tranquility. Perfectly situated near parks and shopping, it’s an ideal base for exploring all this city has to offer. Whether you’re here for live music, history, or dining, our home provides a comfortable space to recharge. We can’t wait to welcome you to The Slayton House!

Other things to note
This is a quiet, residential duplex designed for relaxed stays.

Please note:
• This home is located in a residential area, so a car or rideshare is recommended for restaurants, nightlife, and downtown activities.
• While the space is designed for a quiet, relaxed stay, occasional sound from the neighboring unit or surrounding homes may be heard.
• No parties or events
• Primary guest must be 25+
• Please ensure your reservation reflects the correct number of guests

We kindly ask all guests to review our full house rules prior to booking.
